params.rule_applied: The registered power guard requires at least 8 dates in each regime bucket in validation. The bear bucket holds 4. No verdict is issued in either direction.
params.validation_detail: Validation 2019-2021 contains 4 bear month-ends across 2 episodes, one of which is a single isolated month (2019-01). Effectively one bear event, the COVID crash of 2020. The measured gap is large and positive (+0.368 for momentum_3m, +0.296 for momentum_6m) and rests on that single event. Sampling more finely would not manufacture a second episode, so this window cannot be made to answer the question.
params.in_sample_reversal: The confirmatory in-sample result changed materially once the macro data gap was closed, and the change runs against the hypothesis. The registration named this dependency in advance.
params.in_sample_before_backfill: sp500 macro began 2009-12-31, leaving 45 of 144 dates UNKNOWN and only 10 bear observations, none from the financial crisis. Gap read +0.158 and +0.163 with bear mean IC negative.
params.in_sample_after_backfill: Full coverage from 2004 gives 110 bull and 34 bear dates across 8 distinct bear episodes, no UNKNOWN. Gap falls to +0.054 and +0.071, and bear mean IC is positive (+0.066, +0.038) rather than negative.
params.interpretation: Momentum IC during bear regimes is not negative once the crisis period is included; it is merely lower. The apparent regime effect in the in-sample window was largely an artifact of a truncated macro series that excluded 2007-2009. The evidence that motivated this registration has substantially weakened on its own ground.
params.consequence_for_the_reserve: Out-of-sample from 2022 holds 15 bear months across 5 episodes and would be adequately powered. It was NOT used. The in-sample support that would have justified spending a one-time reserve has largely evaporated, so spending it here would buy a powered test of a hypothesis whose motivating evidence no longer stands.
params.what_this_says_about_P7: The P7 observation that factors scored better in the second half of the window is not explained by bull-versus-bear regime. Whatever produced it, this is not it.
params.method_note: Measuring in-sample twice, before and after the backfill, is not a researcher degree of freedom here. The registration named the macro gap and committed in advance to reporting a shortened window if the backfill failed. Both readings are recorded so the reversal is visible rather than presented as a single clean number.
params.scope_limit: One regime indicator, two factors, one horizon, one universe layer. Says nothing about other regime definitions, which the registration deliberately forbade substituting after the fact.
